question_text: According to the lesson, what are the right ways to use AI in creative projects?

options.text: A. Use AI to brainstorm or kickstart ideas
B. Let AI create everything without checking
C. Use AI to experiment with different tones or styles
D. Use AI-generated outputs as final work without review

A.text: AI is great for getting ideas flowing!

B.text: That’s risky. AI needs human review.

C.text: Yes! Trying different tones is a great use.

D.text: Always review and guide what AI produces.

explanation: Use AI for brainstorming and creative support, not full automation.
